about: Vocal pack for the Neon Drive soundtrack. tools/make-vocals.js turns this into assets/vocals/*.mp3 + pack.js using ElevenLabs. Hooks are spoken/whispered lines placed in intros, breakdowns and builds; chops are sung syllables the engine re-pitches to each track's key for the drops.

hooks.text: Stay with me... till the morning.

chops.prompt: Solo female pop vocal, a cappella, one long sustained 'ooh' sung on a single steady note A4, soft and airy, no instruments, no effects, dry studio recording.
Solo female pop vocal, a cappella, one long sustained 'aah' sung on a single steady note A4, bright and open, no instruments, no effects, dry studio recording.
Solo female pop vocal, a cappella, one sustained 'oh' sung on a single steady note E4, warm, no instruments, no effects, dry studio recording.
Solo female pop vocal, a cappella, a short punchy sung 'hey!' on the note A4, no instruments, no effects, dry studio recording.
Solo female pop vocal, a cappella, a short sung 'yeah' on the note A4, sweet and breathy, no instruments, no effects, dry studio recording.
